name: Blockchain Enterprise Community
description: Professional hub for blockchain builders, enterprise practitioners, legal professionals, and founders — structured for depth, not noise.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Official updates, events, and major news. Follow to crosspost to your server.

channels.name: rules
channels.topic: Community guidelines and code of conduct. Read before posting.

channels.name: roles
channels.topic: Self-assign your role: react to claim Legal Professional, Developer, Founder, or Enterprise Member.

channels.name: roadmap
channels.topic: Community roadmap — events, bootcamp schedule, upcoming workshops. React to vote.

channels.name: introductions
channels.topic: New here? Tell us: who you are, what you build, and one thing you want from this community.

channels.name: general-blockchain
channels.topic: Blockchain general chat — technology, ecosystems, hot takes.

channels.name: defi
channels.topic: DeFi protocols, yield, liquidity, MEV, stablecoins. Data over hype.

channels.name: smart-contracts
channels.topic: Solidity, Rust (Anchor/CosmWasm), Vyper, audits. Post: contract · chain · question.

channels.name: layer2-scaling
channels.topic: Rollups, ZK proofs, state channels, bridges. L2 interop discussions.

channels.name: nft-and-tokenization
channels.topic: Real-world asset tokenization, NFT standards, digital ownership models.

channels.name: protocol-research
channels.topic: Whitepapers, protocol analysis, consensus research. Include a summary.

channels.name: chain-agnostic
channels.topic: Cross-chain interop, multi-chain architecture, chain-neutral tooling.

channels.name: enterprise-blockchain-bootcamp
channels.topic: Structured bootcamp threads — each post is a module or cohort session. Enrollment in #announcements.

channels.name: legal-professionals
channels.topic: For verified legal professionals. Regulatory frameworks, legal precedents, compliance strategy.

channels.name: compliance-regulatory
channels.topic: MiCA, SEC, FINRA, FATF, GDPR intersections with crypto/blockchain. Tag jurisdiction.

channels.name: case-studies
channels.topic: Real enterprise blockchain deployments. Format: industry · chain · problem · outcome.

channels.name: dao-governance
channels.topic: DAO legal structures, on-chain governance, Wyoming DAO LLC, liability models.

channels.name: start-ups
channels.topic: Startup discussions — building in web3, go-to-market, pivots, learnings.

channels.name: fundraising
channels.topic: Raise strategies, SAFT/SAFE, tokenomics for fundraising, VC vs community rounds.

channels.name: investor-relations
channels.topic: Investor deck feedback, cap table structure, term sheet discussions.

channels.name: opportunities
channels.topic: Grants, hackathons, accelerators, ecosystem programs. Include: link · deadline · who it's for.

channels.name: devs
channels.topic: Engineering chat for blockchain and Web3 devs. Stack questions, tooling, integrations.

channels.name: ai-and-blockchain
channels.topic: AI × Web3 — on-chain AI inference, verifiable compute, AI agents for DeFi.

channels.name: open-source
channels.topic: OSS blockchain projects, contributions, PR shoutouts.

channels.name: code-review
channels.topic: Smart contract and protocol code reviews. Include: repo link · what to review · context.

channels.name: tools-and-resources
channels.topic: Dev tools, SDKs, indexers, RPC providers, block explorers worth knowing.

channels.name: jobs-gigs
channels.topic: Full-time, part-time, contract. Format: [HIRE/SEEK] · role · location/remote · link.

channels.name: mentorship
channels.topic: Mentors and mentees connect here. Tag your domain: #solidity #legal #product #growth.

channels.name: resume-and-portfolio
channels.topic: Share resumes, GitHub profiles, or portfolios for community feedback.

channels.name: general
channels.topic: Anything blockchain, crypto, and tech. Hot takes welcome.

channels.name: random-ideas-and-projects
channels.topic: Early ideas, half-baked projects, things you're noodling on. Rough is fine.

channels.name: reads-and-links
channels.topic: Articles, threads, reports worth reading. Include a one-line take.

channels.name: events
channels.topic: Conferences, hackathons, online events. Format: event · date · link · why attend.

channels.name: off-topic
channels.topic: Not blockchain. Everything else.

welcome_screen.description: Blockchain builders, enterprise practitioners, founders, and legal professionals — welcome.

automod_rules.name: Block slurs
automod_rules.block_message: Please keep it professional and respectful. This content is not permitted.

automod_rules.name: Block unsolicited invites
automod_rules.block_message: Server invites require mod approval. DM a moderator.

automod_rules.name: Block self-promotion spam
automod_rules.block_message: Promotional links go in #opportunities. DM a mod for approval.

notes: Set #legal-professionals to visible only for Legal Professional role — others see the channel but cannot read or post.

Role assignment via #roles: use Carl-bot, MEE6, or a custom bot reaction-role setup.
Pair with ai-community.json if the server has an AI track alongside blockchain.
